currentDefinitionReuse: Post-acquisition development ablation: reuse active IDs with matching names and field types, retain active semantics and validate all facts against the current contract. No alias-ID merging or new inference. Original runs retained.

protocol.scope: Source-reported commitments linked to existing quotations. No purchase, shipment execution, arbitrary domain or global cross-source commitment identity claim.
protocol.selection: No gold labels passed to discovery or validation. All failures retained; no retries or answer-based selection.
protocol.safety: Source-reported claims only. The policy is a structural/adoption boundary, not semantic accuracy certification.
protocol.referenceExpansion: Deterministic expansion of direct known quotation references before validating the plan and advancing the shadow registry. Same v2 prompt, model, cases and semantic aliases. Fresh calls on already exposed cases; not a new independent holdout.
protocol.shadowRegistry: Starts with frozen quotations only. Updated by neutral structural checks for allowed sources and existing parent references, never gold answers. All arms later replay the same plans.
protocol.bootstrap: Authored initial quotation fixture; no future concepts in the initial model or discovery prompt.
protocol.developmentRevision: v1 retained: six structural failures, uncertain treatment of explicit unfamiliar facts, and a scoped-identity guard bug found during replay. v2 supplies host limits and authorized reference context explicitly and clarifies discovery versus uncertainty. Cases and semantic aliases unchanged; this is development evidence on reused cases, not a new holdout.

limitations: The planner receives the current shadow registry and source, never gold labels; each acquired plan is replayed into all arms.
The initial app contains no delivery type. The neutral host scopes new IDs to an extension namespace. A policy pass is not semantic qualification.
Source-scoped reported commitments link to quotations through explicit reference identifiers. No autonomous global shipment identity or verified delivery claim.
This is synthetic English text on one small sequential scenario set with maintainer labels; repeated trials are correlated.
The flexible comparator also learns JSONB metadata without physical migrations. Machine timing and author-maintained code are not independent developer-effort measurements.
No manual review actions are issued during adaptation. Pending cases still count against zero-touch usable coverage.
Hosted service, billing and external developer adoption remain unvalidated.
